title: Cancel
description: companion → plugin. Withdraws an open request. stopped is a person's stop; superseded is a newer message; expired is the deadline; failed is the platform refusing or failing a call the request needed, and carries its error.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.

class.description: The platform's error class (request_closed, platform_unavailable, …) or the companion's own (edge_challenge, unreachable). For the machine.

instruction.description: The sentence the agent relays to the person (decision 32). Platform vocabulary, never tenant content.

error.description: Present exactly when reason is failed: decision 32's two halves, relayed from the platform.
